title.vi: 1. Chốt rank definition, freshness và season
title.en: 1. Define ranks, freshness and seasons

paragraphs.vi: Baseline gồm global top-K, own rank, around-me và monthly season; score chỉ từ authoritative game outcomes. Ví dụ visibility target dưới 1 giây sau durable match result khi hệ thống khỏe, với explicit stale/partial policy khi overload. Matchmaking và complex social feeds ngoài baseline. Hỏi exact ordinal rank hay competition/dense rank; “đồng điểm đều hạng 2” khác một unique position trong sorted set.
paragraphs.en: The baseline covers global top-K, own ranks, neighborhoods and monthly seasons, with authoritative game outcomes. An example visibility target is below one second after durable results under healthy conditions, with explicit stale/partial policies under overload. Matchmaking and complex social feeds are outside scope. Exact ordinal positions differ from competition/dense ranks where ties can share rank two.

paragraphs.vi: Tie policy có thể score rồi member ID, earliest achievement hoặc domain rule. Season có timezone/cutoff, trusted event time, late-result grace và freeze/correction policy. Nếu rank dùng trao giải thì không tự đổi requirement thành percentile vì implementation rẻ hơn; approximate ranking là product decision được chốt rõ.
paragraphs.en: Ties can use member IDs, earliest achievement or domain rules. Seasons need timezones/cutoffs, trusted event times and late-result/freeze/correction policies. Award-bearing exact ranks must not silently become percentiles because implementation is cheaper; approximation is an explicit product decision.

title.vi: 2. Đếm player outcomes, queries và peak memory
title.en: 2. Count player outcomes, queries and peak memory

paragraphs.vi: Giả sử 25 triệu monthly players, 5 triệu DAU và 10 scored player outcomes/DAU/ngày. Đây là participation/outcome count, không unique matches khi một match có nhiều người. 50 triệu updates/ngày ≈578,7/s, peak ×5 ≈2.894/s. Rank read QPS phải tính riêng theo active sessions/UI refresh; không suy từ write rate.
paragraphs.en: Assume twenty-five million monthly players, five million DAU and ten scored player outcomes per DAU/day. This counts participation/outcomes, not unique multiplayer matches. Fifty million daily updates average 578.7/second, with an assumed fivefold peak of 2,894/second. Rank reads depend separately on sessions/UI refreshes rather than write rates.

paragraphs.vi: 25M×100 B =2,5 GB chỉ là illustrative resident-entry assumption. Đo actual Redis encoding/member bytes/allocator, version maps, dedup state, replicas, AOF rewrite/fork copy-on-write và simultaneous old/new rebuild generations. Một board vừa một primary có thể là baseline đơn giản nếu benchmark dưới query/update/failure workload; không khẳng định node nào cũng giữ memory đó hoặc đạt tens-of-thousands ops/s.
paragraphs.en: Twenty-five million times one hundred B gives 2.5 GB under an illustrative per-entry assumption. Measure actual encodings/member bytes/allocators, version maps, deduplication state, replicas, AOF rewrite/copy-on-write and overlapping rebuild generations. One primary per board is a simple baseline when benchmarks support the workload/failures, not a universal memory or throughput claim.

title.vi: 3. Public read khác trusted score ingestion
title.en: 3. Public reads differ from trusted score ingestion

paragraphs.vi: Internal outcome API xác thực game service, event signature/identity và rule/season; browser không tự gửi điểm được tin cậy. Dedup identity thường gồm match/outcome + player + scoring/correction version, không chỉ match ID vì một match có nhiều players. Public API limit K/around/page, enforce profile visibility và trả rank definition/freshness.
paragraphs.en: Authenticate game services, identities/signatures and rules/seasons at internal outcome ingestion; browsers do not submit trusted points. Deduplication identities usually include outcomes/matches, players and scoring/correction versions, not match IDs alone. Public APIs bound K/neighborhoods/pages, enforce profile visibility and report rank definitions/freshness.

title.vi: 4. Durable source → projection, không phải hai writes độc lập
title.en: 4. Durable sources precede projections instead of independent dual writes

paragraphs.vi: Baseline transaction ghi unique outcome, aggregate total/version của player/season và outbox trong cùng source DB. Relay phát absolute aggregate event; rank worker apply monotonic version. Nếu history consumer và Redis consumer chạy độc lập trên ephemeral event, Redis có thể hiển thị score chưa durable trong history; phải có authoritative durable log hoặc transaction/outbox giữ source guarantee.
paragraphs.en: A baseline transaction records unique outcomes, per-player/season aggregate totals/versions and outboxes. Relays publish absolute aggregate events; workers apply monotonic versions. Independent history/Redis consumers on ephemeral events can expose scores absent from durable history, requiring authoritative durable logs or transactional sources/outboxes.

paragraphs.vi: Read path lấy rank/score rồi batch hydrate profiles. Redis index là serving projection có durability/failover policy, không là nguồn duy nhất nếu bạn hứa rebuild. History retention, rule versions, corrections và moderation state phải đủ để reconstruct đúng board population/score, không chỉ SUM mọi positive points từng thấy.
paragraphs.en: Reads retrieve ranks/scores then batch-hydrate profiles. Redis is a serving projection under durability/failover policies, not the sole source when rebuilds are promised. Retained history, rules, corrections and moderation must reconstruct populations/scores correctly rather than sum every observed positive event.

caption.vi: History, authoritative aggregate và outbox cùng transaction trong baseline. Redis phục vụ query và có thể rebuild theo season/rule generation; không hứa linearizable cross-shard snapshot từ các reads độc lập.
caption.en: History, authoritative aggregates and outboxes share a baseline transaction. Redis serves queries and can rebuild by season/rule generations; independent reads do not create linearizable cross-shard snapshots.

title.vi: 5. Sorted set trả position nhanh; product rank có thể khác
title.en: 5. Sorted sets return positions efficiently, but product ranks can differ

paragraphs.vi: Redis sorted sets hỗ trợ update/rank O(log N); range trả M members thường O(log N+M), không O(log N) bất kể output size. Skiplist spans hỗ trợ order statistics ở large encoding; engine có compact encoding cho set nhỏ. SQL index score hỗ trợ top-K tốt, nhưng generic B-tree không tự có stored subtree counts cho arbitrary exact ordinal rank; count higher entries có thể scan nhiều index entries tùy plan/selectivity. SQL vẫn hợp workload nhỏ hoặc snapshot/offline ranks.
paragraphs.en: Redis sorted sets support logarithmic updates/ranks, while ranges returning M members typically cost O(log N+M), not logarithmic regardless of output. Skiplist spans support large-set order statistics, with compact encodings for small sets. SQL score indexes handle top-K well, but generic B-trees do not inherently store arbitrary ordinal-rank subtree counts; counting preceding entries can scan many entries depending on plans/selectivity. SQL remains valid for small workloads or offline/snapshot ranks.

paragraphs.vi: Redis ascending order dùng score rồi byte-lexicographic member; REV đảo cả score và tie direction. ZREVRANK là zero-based ordinal position; UI thường cộng 1. Competition rank =1+count(score greater), dense rank =1+count(distinct greater scores), không phải lúc nào ZREVRANK cũng là rank product muốn. Demo dùng ASCII IDs để byte order dễ kiểm.
paragraphs.en: Ascending Redis order uses score then member byte lexicographic order; REV reverses both scores and ties. ZREVRANK returns zero-based ordinal positions, commonly displayed plus one. Competition ranks count higher-scoring players, while dense ranks count distinct higher scores, so ZREVRANK does not implement every product rank. The demo uses ASCII IDs for transparent byte ordering.

title.vi: 6. Tie-breaking không được làm score mất precision
title.en: 6. Tie-breaking must not destroy score precision

paragraphs.vi: Redis score là double; integers trong supported exact range có thể biểu diễn chính xác nhưng arbitrary decimal/composite values có thể collide do rounding. Ví dụ pack points×2^32+tieBits chỉ exact nếu bounds/tie domain chứng minh tổng nằm trong safe integer budget; không nhét Unix milliseconds tùy ý vào 32 bits. Trong JavaScript dùng conservative Number.isSafeInteger hoặc integer representation/validation phù hợp trước gửi.
paragraphs.en: Redis scores are doubles: supported integers are exact, but arbitrary decimals/composites can collide through rounding. Packing points×2^32+tieBits needs proven bounds and safe integer totals; arbitrary Unix milliseconds do not fit thirty-two bits. Use conservative JavaScript safe-integer checks or suitable integer representations/validation before submission.

paragraphs.vi: Earliest-to-reach cần định nghĩa timestamp source, precision, season epoch và behavior sau penalty/correction. Nếu pack composite score thì ZINCRBY raw points không còn update đúng tuple; cần atomic compute/set cùng dedup/version guard hoặc ordered index hỗ trợ comparator thật. Equal packed tie vẫn cần deterministic final tie-breaker. Không claim Redis native member comparator tùy ý đổi được bằng một config.
paragraphs.en: Earliest-achievement ties need timestamp sources, precision, season epochs and penalty/correction rules. Composite packing invalidates raw-point ZINCRBY updates; use atomic compute/set with dedup/version guards or indexes supporting actual tuple comparators. Equal packed ties still need deterministic final ordering. Redis member comparisons are not arbitrary configurable comparators.

title.vi: 7. Duplicate và out-of-order events cần xử lý tại projection boundary
title.en: 7. Handle duplicate/reordered events at the projection boundary

paragraphs.vi: ZINCRBY cộng hai lần nếu worker update Redis rồi crash trước commit offset. Dedup ở source DB chỉ bảo vệ source, không tự bảo vệ side effect Redis. Có thể dùng atomic dedup marker+delta update trong cùng serving shard với retention compatible replay, hoặc absolute aggregate total + monotonic per-player/season version trong một atomic apply. Demo dùng phương án absolute; source phải aggregate outcomes đúng và tăng version cả khi correction giảm score.
paragraphs.en: ZINCRBY double-counts when workers update Redis then crash before offset commits. Source deduplication protects the source, not Redis side effects. Options include atomic marker-plus-delta updates with replay-compatible retention or atomic absolute totals plus monotonic player/season versions. The demo uses absolute totals, relying on correct source aggregation and newer versions even for downward corrections.

paragraphs.vi: Version map và score key cần chung atomicity/Redis Cluster slot nếu dùng script. Lua execution atomic với commands khác nhưng runtime error không rollback writes đã xảy ra; validate types/limits/key state trước mutation và có rebuild/reconcile path. Stale worker không được trộn active generation; an toàn của projection còn phụ thuộc persistence/failover và source watermark recovery.
paragraphs.en: Version maps and score keys need shared atomicity/Cluster slots for scripts. Lua execution is atomic relative to other commands, but runtime errors do not roll back prior writes: validate types/limits/key states first and provide rebuild/reconciliation. Stale workers must not mix generations, and projection safety also depends on persistence/failover and source-watermark recovery.

title.vi: 8. Một ZSET key không tự trải qua cả Redis Cluster
title.en: 8. One ZSET key does not automatically span Redis Cluster

paragraphs.vi: Scale nhiều boards/seasons qua keys khác, read replicas/caches theo freshness policy trước khi split một board. Redis Cluster đặt một key ở một slot; thêm nodes không tự chia giant sorted set. Nếu hash-shard users, global top-K có thể merge local top-K từ mọi shard khi cùng order/filter/snapshot: một global top-K member không thể nằm sau K member trong chính shard của nó.
paragraphs.en: Distribute boards/seasons across keys and add freshness-aware read replicas/caches before splitting one board. Redis Cluster places one key in one slot; adding nodes does not split giant sorted sets. User-hash sharding can merge local top-K from all shards under common orders/filters/snapshots: global top-K members cannot follow K members within their own shard.

paragraphs.vi: Exact ordinal rank phải đếm tuple đứng trước target trên mọi shard: greater score cộng equal-score member đứng trước theo tie rule. Chỉ sum ZCOUNT(score greater) trả competition rank, không ordinal. Independent shard reads ở các thời điểm khác không chứng minh một instant global snapshot; missing shard phải partial/fail theo contract. Demo giữ dataset frozen để kiểm arithmetic.
paragraphs.en: Exact ordinal ranks count tuples preceding targets on every shard: greater scores plus preceding equal-score members under the tie rule. Summing only greater-score counts gives competition rather than ordinal rank. Independent shard reads at different times do not establish a global snapshot; missing shards require partial/failure behavior. The demo freezes data to isolate arithmetic.

title.vi: 9. Range sharding và histogram đổi chi phí query
title.en: 9. Range sharding and histograms change query costs

paragraphs.vi: Score-range sharding giữ higher-range counts cộng local rank nhưng players migrate khi score/correction qua boundary. Cần consistent ownership/count updates và split hot ranges; top-K có thể đọc nhiều ranges nếu highest range ít players. Hash sharding cân key count chứ không bảo đảm QPS uniform; merge candidates có network/CPU cost theo shards×K và tail latency theo slow shard.
paragraphs.en: Score-range sharding combines higher-range counts with local ranks but migrates players across score/correction boundaries. Ownership/count updates must remain consistent, with hot-range splitting; sparse highest ranges can make top-K span several ranges. Hashing balances key counts rather than necessarily QPS. Candidate merging costs network/CPU proportional to shards times K and waits for slow shards.

paragraphs.vi: Exact top-K cộng approximate percentile/histogram là lựa chọn product hợp lệ nếu users/awards chấp nhận. Histogram update phải decrement old bucket và increment new bucket, xử lý duplicates/corrections/population change; counts incoherent làm interval sai. Nêu percentile/tie definition, bucket resolution/error bound và as-of timestamp. Demo interval từ cùng frozen histogram không là proof pipeline live histogram tự exact.
paragraphs.en: Exact top-K plus approximate percentiles/histograms is valid when product/awards permit. Histograms must decrement old buckets and increment new ones while handling duplicates, corrections and population changes; incoherent counts invalidate intervals. Specify percentile/tie definitions, resolution/error bounds and as-of times. Frozen-demo intervals do not prove live histogram pipelines exact.

title.vi: 10. Rank và around-me phải dùng cùng view
title.en: 10. Ranks and neighborhoods need a coherent view

paragraphs.vi: ZREVRANK rồi ZRANGE ở hai network calls có thể race với score update: around window không còn quanh user. Dùng atomic read script/protocol trên cùng key hoặc snapshot/generation view phù hợp; profile hydrate sau không tự phá score view, nhưng ban/eligibility đổi phải có semantics riêng. Nếu live best-effort là acceptable thì nói rõ response không là fixed snapshot.
paragraphs.en: Separate ZREVRANK/ZRANGE calls can race updates and yield neighborhoods no longer surrounding users. Use atomic reads on the same key or suitable snapshot/generation views. Profile hydration need not alter score views, while eligibility/bans need explicit semantics. Clearly label acceptable live best-effort responses instead of claiming fixed snapshots.

paragraphs.vi: Offset pagination trên live ranking có thể duplicate/skip khi players di chuyển. Query-bound cursor cần season/rank policy/generation và last tuple, nhưng tuple cursor cũng không tạo snapshot nếu data vẫn đổi. Snapshot leaderboard hoặc frozen tournament results cho stable pages; retention/cursor expiry phải tương thích. Missing profile không nên xóa row rồi reassign rank nếu product rank population vẫn gồm player đó.
paragraphs.en: Offset paging over live ranks can duplicate/skip moving players. Cursors bind seasons/rank policies/generations and last tuples, but tuple cursors alone do not freeze changing data. Snapshot/finalized boards provide stable pages with compatible retention/expiry. Missing profiles should not silently remove players and reassign ranks while the population still includes them.

title.vi: 11. Rollover, late results và rebuild cần watermarks
title.en: 11. Rollovers, late results and rebuilds need watermarks

paragraphs.vi: New season dùng key/generation mới thay vì mass reset một hot key. Trusted season assignment xác định theo finalized match time hoặc ingestion time đã chọn, timezone và grace; late event sau freeze được reject/archive/correct theo policy. Awards cần finalization watermark và replay/audit, không chỉ EXPIREAT theo clock. Old board retention phục vụ history/appeals khác cache TTL.
paragraphs.en: New seasons use new keys/generations rather than mass resets. Trusted season assignment follows chosen finalized-match or ingestion times, timezones and grace policies; post-freeze events are rejected, archived or corrected explicitly. Awards need finalization watermarks/replays/audits rather than expiry clocks alone. Old-board history/appeal retention differs from cache TTL.

paragraphs.vi: Rebuild source snapshot tại consistent watermark, project full totals/rules/eligibility vào fresh generation rồi replay tail sau watermark. Validate member counts, score sums và sampled ranks trước publish; giữ stream retention đủ thời gian rebuild và partition-offset vector khi không có single global cursor. Không snapshot rồi lấy newest offset để bỏ qua tail. Current projection AOF/replicas có RPO/RTO riêng; repair/rebuild là plan được đo, không hứa “Redis mất thì rebuild tức thì”.
paragraphs.en: Rebuild consistent source snapshots at watermarks into fresh generations with totals/rules/eligibility, then replay subsequent tails. Validate counts, score sums and sampled ranks, retain streams long enough and use partition-offset vectors when no global cursor exists. Taking newest offsets after snapshots can skip tails. AOF/replicas have specific RPO/RTO; measure recovery rather than promising instant rebuilds.

title.vi: 12. Friends, moderation và profile privacy
title.en: 12. Friends, moderation and profile privacy

paragraphs.vi: Friends board nhỏ có thể batch read F member scores và sort O(F log F), lấy top-K hoặc quanh user; fetching O(F) không làm sort miễn phí. Kiểm friendship/visibility, blocklist và cross-region restrictions trước hydrate; global rank không tự là friends rank. Nhiều social boards lớn có thể cần materialized audience projections với update fanout và policy lifecycle.
paragraphs.en: Small friends boards can batch-read F scores and sort in O(F log F) for top-K/neighborhoods; linear fetching does not make sorting free. Check friendships, visibility, blocks and regional policies before hydration; global ranks are not friends ranks. Large social audiences can need materialized projections with fanout and policy lifecycles.

paragraphs.vi: Authenticate game service, verify replay/rule bounds và giữ outcome evidence cho anti-cheat review. Ban/remove/correction phải durable tại source và propagate index/cache/archive theo policy; ZREM tạm rồi rebuild từ unfiltered history sẽ hồi sinh người bị loại. Scoring-rule changes cần versioned recomputation, không tùy tiện cộng penalty event nhiều lần khi retry.
paragraphs.en: Authenticate game services, verify replay/rule bounds and retain outcome evidence for anti-cheat review. Persist bans/removals/corrections at sources and propagate under policy: temporary ZREM plus unfiltered rebuilds can resurrect excluded players. Scoring-rule changes need versioned recomputation rather than repeatedly adding retried penalties.

title.vi: 13. Đo score-to-visible và rebuild trong failure drills
title.en: 13. Measure score visibility and rebuilds during failure drills

paragraphs.vi: Metric gồm durable outcome→projection-visible latency theo season/region, stale-version rejection, score mismatches với source, index member count, hot key CPU, replication/AOF lag, query partial rate, profile hydration latency và rebuild ETA. Theo dõi scoring corrections/bans và awards-finalization errors riêng. Failover test phải kiểm score/version marker khớp, không chỉ Redis ping thành công.
paragraphs.en: Measure durable-outcome-to-visible latency by season/region, stale-version rejections, source/projection mismatches, membership, hot-key CPU, replication/AOF lag, partial queries, hydration latency and rebuild ETAs. Track corrections/bans and award-finalization errors separately. Failovers must preserve score/version consistency, not merely restore Redis pings.

rows.vi: Update rồi crash trước offset ACK
rows.en: Update then crash before offset acknowledgement
Replay does not add scores again.
Version two arrives before version one

rows.vi: Absolute score không downgrade bởi stale retry.
rows.en: Stale retries do not downgrade absolute scores.

rows.vi: Version cao hơn được apply dù score thấp hơn.
rows.en: Newer versions apply even when scores decrease.

rows.vi: Không gọi partial result là exact complete rank.
rows.en: Partial results are not labeled exact complete ranks.

rows.vi: Coherent view hoặc declared best-effort semantics.
rows.en: Coherent views or declared best-effort semantics.

rows.vi: Không revive excluded player hoặc skip tail.
rows.en: Excluded players are not revived and tails are not skipped.

title.vi: 14. Câu hỏi phỏng vấn về rank, replay và distributed view
title.en: 14. Interview questions on ranks, replay and distributed views

paragraphs.vi: Trả lời bằng sorted tuple, event identity, projection boundary và snapshot semantics. Test brute-force sorted fixture với sharded merge trước khi dùng complexity để biện hộ architecture.
paragraphs.en: Explain sorted tuples, event identities, projection boundaries and snapshot semantics. Validate sharded merges against brute-force fixtures before using complexity to justify architecture.

question.vi: ZREVRANK có luôn là rank người chơi muốn không?
question.en: Does ZREVRANK always give the desired player rank?

answer.vi: Nó là zero-based ordinal position theo score/member ordering. Competition/dense rank có tie semantics khác. REV đảo lexical tie direction; earliest achievement cần ordered model/encoding có bounds rõ.
answer.en: It is a zero-based ordinal position under score/member ordering. Competition/dense ranks differ on ties. REV reverses lexical ties; earliest-achievement rules need explicit ordering/encoding bounds.

question.vi: Dedup matchId ở source đã đủ chống ZINCRBY lặp chưa?
question.en: Does source match-ID deduplication prevent repeated ZINCRBY effects?

answer.vi: Chưa. Redis update rồi crash trước offset ACK vẫn replay. Atomic dedup+delta hoặc absolute aggregate+version tại projection boundary; identity gồm player/correction vì match có nhiều outcomes.
answer.en: No. Redis updates followed by pre-ACK crashes can replay. Use atomic deduplication/deltas or absolute aggregates/versions at the projection boundary, with player/correction-aware identities.

question.vi: Hash-shard global rank chỉ cần sum higher scores?
question.en: Does hash-sharded global rank only sum higher scores?

answer.vi: Đó là competition rank. Ordinal còn equal-score member đứng trước theo tie order. Cần target tuple đúng version và consistent shard view nếu claim exact global snapshot.
answer.en: That gives competition rank. Ordinal ranks also count preceding equal-score members, using correct target versions and coherent shard views when claiming exact snapshots.

question.vi: Một shard timeout có trả những top-K còn lại như complete được không?
question.en: Can available-shard top-K be returned as complete after one timeout?

answer.vi: Không bảo đảm missing shard không chứa top players. Mark partial hoặc fail theo contract; local top-K union proof cần mọi shard và cùng ordering/filter/view.
answer.en: Missing shards may contain leading players. Mark partial or fail under the contract; the union proof requires all shards and common orders/filters/views.

question.vi: Tại sao không cộng timestamp nhỏ vào score float để tie-break?
question.en: Why not add a small timestamp fraction to scores for ties?

answer.vi: Double precision và score magnitude có thể làm fraction biến mất hoặc reorder sai. Chứng minh domain/safe integer packing hoặc dùng ordered index comparator phù hợp; packed score update không là raw ZINCRBY points.
answer.en: Floating precision/magnitudes can erase fractions or reorder ties. Prove bounded safe packing or use appropriate tuple indexes; packed updates are not raw-point increments.

question.vi: Redis Cluster tự chia giant ZSET khi thêm node?
question.en: Does adding Redis Cluster nodes split a giant ZSET?

answer.vi: Không, một key thuộc một slot. Split board phải đổi data model/query fanout/count consistency hoặc chọn approximate policy được product chấp nhận.
answer.en: No: one key occupies one slot. Splitting boards changes models, fanout/count consistency or explicitly accepted approximation policies.

question.vi: Rebuild bằng SUM(points) có luôn khôi phục đúng không?
question.en: Does rebuilding with SUM(points) always restore the board?

answer.vi: Chỉ nếu source/rules/retention bao phủ dedup, corrections, eligibility và season. Cần snapshot watermark + tail replay + generation publish; bỏ ban/correction hoặc lấy offset sai sẽ restore wrong score.
answer.en: Only with sufficient sources/rules/retention covering deduplication, corrections, eligibility and seasons. Use snapshot watermarks, tail replay and generation publication; missing policies/incorrect offsets restore wrong scores.

question.vi: Có thể đổi mọi rank thấp thành percentile để scale không?
question.en: Can all lower ranks be replaced with percentiles for scale?

answer.vi: Là product trade-off, không tự đổi khi exact ranks/awards đã được yêu cầu. Nếu chấp nhận approximation, công bố definition, bucket resolution/error/as-of và giữ histogram updates coherent.
answer.en: That is a product trade-off, not an automatic replacement for requested exact ranks/awards. Accepted approximations need explicit definitions, resolutions/errors/as-of times and coherent histogram updates.
